not_tested: Tailscale account authentication and Serve HTTPS over the Unix socket
full Compose Core/Worker/Supervisor/provider E2E after this network-isolation change
security_notes: The isolation change is required because Netavark 2.1.0 did not include an internal bridge in the isolation chain; the Tailscale uplink could reach Core's control listener even though the two services shared no network. Netavark's isolate option applies to non-internal bridges, so control is non-internal with no_default_route=true.
Rootless Podman and the nested runtime remain TRUSTED_LOCAL and are not SEC-01 isolation.
No Tailscale auth key, login URL, session cookie, CSRF value, pairing code or bootstrap code is recorded here.
The disposable project was removed with down -v; zero project containers, volumes or networks remained.
